title: DC Franchise Overview
body:
DC's characters originated in comic books published from the late 1930s, including the first appearances of Superman in 1938 and Batman in 1939, and later reached film and television in successive adaptations documented in public release records.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — titles, credited creators, publication and release years and formats — in original wording, with no copied comic text or script excerpts.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original heroes and cities, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by DC or Warner Bros.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

print("DC Franchise Database | public edition")
print("Works recorded: 10")
print("First work year: 1938 | Last work year: 2022")

Works recorded: 10
First work year: 1938 | Last work year: 2022

title: DC Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Action Comics #1 (first Superman comic) (1938) and ending with The Batman (2022). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

The full order is: Action Comics #1 (first Superman comic) (1938); Detective Comics #27 (first Batman comic) (1939); Superman (film) (1978); Batman (film) (1989); The Dark Knight (2008); Man of Steel (2013); Wonder Woman (2017); Aquaman (2018); Joker (2019); The Batman (2022). Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.

This guide contains facts only. It does not reproduce story text, and it does not claim that any Signature continuation belongs in the official order.

print("Works in public order: " + str(len(order)))
print("First: " + order[0])
print("Last: " + order[-1])
